mapper.select: SELECT `dev`.`id`, `dev`.`device_code` AS `code`, `dev`.`device_name` AS `name`, `dev_iot`.`iot_device_brand_code` AS `brandCode`, `dev_iot`.`iot_device_brand_name` AS `brandName`, `dev_iot`.`iot_device_product_id` AS `iotDeviceProductId`, `dev_iot`.`iot_device_product_name` AS `iotDeviceProductName`, `dev_iot`.`iot_device_model_name` AS `iotDeviceModelName`, `dev_iot`.`iot_device_number_code` AS `iotDeviceNumberCode`, `dev`.`device_biz_type` AS `genreId`, `dev_exp`.`purchase_date` AS `purchaseDate`, `dev_exp`.`unit_price` AS `purchasePrice`, `dev`.`area_id` AS `areaId`, `dev`.`area_name` AS `areaName`, `dev`.`area_last_id`, `dev`.`department_id` AS `departmentId`, `dev`.`department_name` AS `departmentName`, `dev_exp`.`install_unit`, `dev_exp`.`install_phone`, `dev_exp`.`install_date`, `dev`.`manager_ids` AS `managerJson`, `dev`.`manager_names` AS `managerUserName`, `dev_exp`.`useful_life`, `dev_exp`.`daily_work_time`, `dev`.`create_time`, `dev`.`tenant`, `dev_exp`.`picture` AS `images`, `dev_exp`.`lnt_and_lat` AS `lntAndLat`, `dev`.`thirdparty_id` AS `thirdPartyId`, `dev`.`thirdparty_cfg`, `dev`.`device_state` AS `deviceState` FROM `center_biz_device` `dev` LEFT JOIN `center_biz_device_expand` `dev_exp` ON `dev_exp`.`id` = `dev`.`id` LEFT JOIN `center_biz_device_iot` `dev_iot` ON `dev_iot`.`id` = `dev`.`id` WHERE `dev`.`id` = #{deviceId}

SELECT `dev`.`id` AS `device_id`, `dev`.`device_code`, `dev`.`device_name`, `dev_iot`.`iot_device_brand_code` AS `brand_code`, `dev_iot`.`iot_device_brand_name` AS `brand_name`, `dev_iot`.`iot_device_product_id`, `dev_iot`.`iot_device_product_name`, `dev`.`device_biz_type` AS `genre_Id`, `dev`.`area_id`, `dev`.`area_name`, `dev`.`area_last_id` AS `single_area_id`, `dev`.`department_id`, `dev`.`department_name`, `dev_exp`.`lnt_and_lat`, `dev`.`thirdparty_id`, `dev`.`thirdparty_cfg`, `dev`.`device_state` FROM `center_biz_device` `dev` LEFT JOIN `center_biz_device_iot` `dev_iot` ON `dev_iot`.`id` = `dev`.`id` LEFT JOIN `center_biz_device_expand` `dev_exp` ON `dev_exp`.`id` = `dev`.`id` WHERE `dev`.`id` = #{deviceId}

SELECT `dev`.`id`, `dev`.`device_name`, `dev`.`device_code`, `dev`.`department_id`, `dev`.`device_iot_prod_id` AS `iotProductId`, `dev`.`area_id`, `dev`.`area_name`, `dev`.`area_last_id`, `dev`.`device_state`, `dev`.`manager_ids`, `dev`.`manager_names`, `dev`.`thirdparty_id`, `dev`.`thirdparty_cfg`, `iot_prod`.`prod_name` AS `iotProductName`, `iot_prod`.`prod_model_name` AS `iotModelName`, `iot_prod`.`prod_brand_name` AS `iotBrandName`, `iot_prod`.`prod_pic` AS `iotProductPicture`, `iot_prod`.`prod_icon` AS `iotProductIcon`, `iot_prod`.`prod_category_name` AS `iotProductCategoryName`, `iot_prod`.`prod_category_name_concat` AS `iotProductCategoryNameConcat`, `iot_prod`.`prod_category_code` AS `iotProductCategoryCode`, `iot_prod`.`prod_category_concat` AS `iotProductCategoryCodeConcat` FROM `center_biz_device` `dev` LEFT JOIN `iot_prod_view` `iot_prod` ON `dev`.`device_iot_prod_id` = `iot_prod`.`id` LEFT JOIN `center_biz_tag_ref` `dev_tag_ref` ON `dev`.`id` = `dev_tag_ref`.`business_key` WHERE `dev`.`id` = #{deviceId}

SELECT `c`.`category_name` AS `genreName`, COUNT(1) AS `num` FROM `center_biz_device` `dev` LEFT JOIN `iot_prod_view` `b` ON `dev`.`device_iot_prod_id` = `b`.`id` AND `b`.`tenant` = #{tenant} AND `b`.`deleted` = 0 LEFT JOIN `iot_category_view` `c` ON `b`.`prod_category_code` = `c`.`category_code` AND `c`.`tenant` = #{tenant} AND `b`.`deleted` = 0
AND `dev`.`id` IN
#{id}
GROUP BY `c`.`category_name`

SELECT `area_name`, `area_last_id` AS `area_id`, COUNT(1) AS `num` FROM `center_biz_device`
AND `id` IN
#{id}
GROUP BY `area_last_id` ORDER BY `num` DESC
SELECT `id` FROM `center_biz_device`

SELECT `dev_exp`.`lnt_and_lat`, 0 AS `icon` -- 原始 统计的是 正常设备，先没有正常设备的状态，只有在线离线，所以先都显示 0 FROM `center_biz_device` `dev` LEFT JOIN `center_biz_device_expand` `dev_exp` ON `dev_exp`.`id` = `dev`.`id` WHERE `dev_exp`.`lnt_and_lat` IS NOT NULL AND `dev_exp`.`lnt_and_lat` != '' GROUP BY `dev_exp`.`lnt_and_lat`

SELECT `dev`.`id` as `deviceId`, `dev`.`device_name` FROM `center_biz_device` `dev` left join `center_biz_device_expand` `dev_exp` on `dev_exp`.id = `dev`.id WHERE `dev_exp`.`lnt_and_lat` = #{lntAndLat}

SELECT `dev`.`id` AS `deviceId`, `dev`.`device_name` AS `deviceInstanceName`, `dev`.`device_code` AS `code`, `dev`.`area_id`, `dev`.`area_name`, `dev`.`device_biz_type` AS `genreId` FROM `center_biz_device` `dev`
`dev`.`device_name` LIKE CONCAT('%',#{name},'%')
AND
`dev`.`id` NOT IN
#{id}

SELECT `id` FROM `center_biz_device` WHERE `device_iot_prod_id` IN
#{productId}

SELECT `dev`.`id` FROM `center_biz_device` `dev` INNER JOIN `iot_prod_view` `iotp` ON `dev`.`device_iot_prod_id` = `iotp`.`id` WHERE `iotp`.`prod_category_concat` LIKE CONCAT(#{prodCategoryCodeConcat}, '%')
SELECT `dev`.`id` AS `deviceId` FROM `center_biz_device` `dev` WHERE `dev`.`manager_ids` LIKE CONCAT('%', #{managerId}, '%')
SELECT `id`, `useful_life`, `daily_work_time`, `install_date` FROM `center_biz_device_expand`

select t1.*, GROUP_CONCAT( REPLACE ( `t3`.`tag_code`, 'builtin.app::', '' ) SEPARATOR ',' ) AS `applicationCode` from ( SELECT `cbd`.`id`, `cbd`.`device_state` AS `status`, `ipv`.`prod_category_name` AS `iotDeviceProdCategoryName`, `cbd`.`device_name`, `ipv`.`prod_name` AS `iotDeviceProdName`, `cbd`.`area_id`, `cbd`.`area_name`, `cbd`.`department_id`, `cbd`.`department_name`, `cbd`.`tenant`, `cbd`.`deleted`, `cbd`.`create_by`, `cbd`.`create_time`, `cbd`.`update_by`, `cbd`.`update_time` FROM `center_biz_device` `cbd` LEFT JOIN `iot_prod_view` `ipv` ON `cbd`.`device_iot_prod_id` = `ipv`.`id` LEFT JOIN `center_biz_tag_ref` `cbtr` ON `cbtr`.`business_key` = `cbd`.`id` LEFT JOIN (SELECT `tag_code`, `tag_name`, `id` FROM `center_biz_tag` WHERE `tag_code` LIKE CONCAT('builtin.app::', '%')) `cbt` ON `cbt`.`id` = `cbtr`.`tag_id`
`cbd`.`tenant` = #{tenant}
and (`cbd`.`update_time` BETWEEN #{period.begin} AND #{period.end} or `cbtr`.`update_time` BETWEEN #{period.begin} AND #{period.end})
GROUP BY cbd.id ) t1 LEFT JOIN `center_biz_tag_ref` `t2` ON `t2`.`business_key` = `t1`.`id` and t2.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN (SELECT `tag_code`, `tag_name`, `id` FROM `center_biz_tag` WHERE `tag_code` LIKE CONCAT('builtin.app::', '%')) `t3` ON `t3`.`id` = `t2`.`tag_id` group by t1.id

SELECT `cbde`.* FROM `center_biz_device` `dev` INNER JOIN `center_biz_device_expand` `cbde` ON `cbde`.`id` = `dev`.`id`
`cbde`.`spatial_coordinates` is not null
AND `dev`.`area_last_id` LIKE CONCAT('%',#{areaId},'%')
